correctness.rationale: Two complete acyclic 53-pair discrete-Morse matchings on 110 nonempty simplices, with all 304 face incidences checked, give one 0-cell, two 2-cells and one 3-cell, integral top boundary (-1,1). Primitive attaching vector yields S2 by Hurewicz and CW cancellation; independent +1 integer boundary minor, mod-two boundary ranks 7,21,26, and octahedral primitive generator cross-check. Exact graph-automorphism and signed Hopf traces for all 16 dihedral maps prove both generators act by -1. All executable assertions replayed on complete standalone code.

Public records about Q3 ordinary four-cuts, Wagner total three-cuts and all-size Möbius ordinary three-cuts differ by graph or defining cut parameter. Exact intrinsic octahedral primitive cycle and dihedral H2 orientation character are not implied by those results. Full-text checks and targeted public-record searches support best-knowledge originality; unindexed literature is a residual risk.

value.rationale: The Wagner graph is a canonical eight-vertex cubic vertex-transitive Möbius ladder. Its four-cut homotopy is a natural non-shellable pure three-dimensional case at girth four, outside large-girth family theorems. Its primitive octahedral geometric cycle and full integral dihedral sign character add structural and symmetry information beyond f-vectors or Euler characteristic, allowing a precise comparison with Q3 ordinary four-cuts. Scope is an exact natural finite classification, not a claim of general-family theorem.
